{
 "path": "programs/task-a6490146.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    if not cells:
        return grid
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    return [[grid[h - 1 - r][w - 1 - c] if grid[r][c] == 3 else grid[r][c]
             for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)] for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
"
}
